reviews.review: Amazing soundtrack, unprecedented gameplay, and gruelingly difficult. Want something new and challenging? This is the game for you.
Even though i just started playing, its pretty fun

Let me start off by saying that I really want to like this game. I love the asthetics of this game. I enjoy the gameplay, I love the mix of items and variety, and even the timer that slowly ramps up the difficulty adds that extra layer to give it more play time.

Now, while I may have only played about 2 hours of the game as of writing this review, I can honestly say I would adore this game if it functioned properly. 

When I can combat roll on the spot, and activate my abilities (and basic attack) it has a tight, amazing feel to it, and I know that every mistake is my own.

When the game decides to lock up and continue to use an ability every time it cools down, or spam the basic attack non-stop, it is utterly infuriating. It is so annoying when I'm doing well, dodging a boss, and my character decides to start spamming Machine Gun which considerably slows him down and or locks him in place, and the only way to move is awkwardly jump to and frow, smashing the various abilities in hopes that it stops.

I really like this game when it works, but when it refuses to, I could lose it. I've tried various fixes, including resetting my computer, the game, steam, and checking the buttons themselves, but they all seem to be functioning normally. Risk of Rain is great otherwise, but with this glitch, it's next to unplayable.

This game is so good I don't even know where to start!
* Very fun gameplay, especially with friends around!
* Many different item loadouts, generated randomly throughout each game
* Lots of fun and hard challenges
* Different types of game modes (obtainable through gameplay) which make the game way more interesting!
* Replay, replay, replay... Not a single gameplay will be the same
* Strange, fearsome enemies that have many different abilities
* Increasing-over-time diffiiculty
* Hours and hours of fun!!!
Highly recommended game, purchase right away!
Great game. I've spent countless hours with friends on this insanely fun game.
